about:
Angel Factory operates from Garland, Texas, in the Dallas metropolitan area. The company has been producing apparel since the early 1990s as a full-service sewing contractor. No founders or ownership structure are disclosed in public materials.

The shop handles all types of men's, women's, and children's clothing, offering in-house design, fabric cutting, reworking, embroidery, finishing, and packaging. It works with a broad range of textiles including cotton, knits, wovens, fleece, lycra, cotton lace, rayon, polyester, and pima cotton. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Angel Factory serves fashion designers and wholesalers who need cut-and-sew production for their lines. The company emphasizes that it accepts orders of any size, stating that no client is too big or too small.

The business positions itself on quality and breadth of service, promoting a one-stop experience from design through finished, packaged goods. It highlights the trust of multiple designers and wholesalers as evidence of its reliability.
